answer: Make pay vest like a lotus opening: slowly, and only for keys that keep showing up. A new identity earns 5% of full reward in its first epoch and climbs one step per epoch it answers and passes review, reaching full pay after about 20 epochs; a missed epoch drops it a step. A farmer can still spin up an atlas of a thousand keys, but each must survive twenty graded epochs before it pays well, so the cost is sustained work, not one setup. Tradeoff: honest newcomers cross a canyon of thin pay, so a bonded sponsor can halve the ramp.
